ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (dark) dominant surface with high-intensity (white) localized pixel clusters; estimated high-to-low intensity ratio of 15:85.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly dense and distinct circular scar patterning creating a 'starry' visual distribution across the primary dark pigmentation.
